title: Fabric Sources
description:
Stage 2 of the Fabric track. The contract with upstream: every system ingested from, every entity it delivers, every column it emits, and every defect it is known to contain.

This is the only place a source column is declared. Because 01-scaffolding sets `require_exhaustive_column_mapping`, a column declared here must be mapped or explicitly excluded downstream -- so a new upstream column becomes a review, never a silent drop.

AUTHORITATIVE -- a non-conforming spec fails the build.

name.description: Source system id. Appears in bronze table names, so provenance is readable without opening lineage.

domain.description: Must match a domain declared in 01-scaffolding.yaml.

owner.description: The upstream team, not the data team.

location.description: Deployed location. Use ${VAR} for anything environment-specific.

location_dev.description: Local path used before a real landing zone exists.

infer_schema.description: Should be false. Inference reads the file twice and lets the schema change silently when the data changes -- which is exactly the drift the landing checks exist to catch.

delivery_by.description: When upstream commits to delivering, e.g. '02:00 IST'.

known_issues.description: Defects upstream is KNOWN to contain, with observed rates. Silver cleansing rules trace back to these ids, so a rule reads as a deliberate response to a named problem rather than defensive guesswork -- and the validator can prove every documented defect is handled.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. DUP-001. Referenced by silver rules.

observed_rate.description: Measured share, not a guess. Data-quality thresholds are calibrated from this.

handled_by.description: layer.table.rule that deals with it, e.g. silver.stg_orders.deduplicate.

watermark_column.description: Column the incremental load compares against its high-water mark. Required when load_pattern is incremental -- without it bronze re-appends the whole source on every run, and downstream deduplication hides it.

expected_row_order.description: Order of magnitude, for anomaly detection. Catches a truncated or duplicated export.

references_columns.description: Named `references_columns`, not `on` -- a bare `on:` key parses as boolean true under YAML 1.1.

column.description: additionalProperties is false on purpose. In YAML flow style an unquoted comma ends the value, so `description: Natural key, format "X"` silently becomes a truncated description PLUS a null-valued key. Rejecting unknown keys turns that into a build failure instead of quietly losing half the documentation.

domain_values.description: Closed value set. Enforced downstream by enforce_allowed_values.

pii.description: Classification drives masking. 01-scaffolding `require_pii_classification` fails the build if a PII column reaches silver unmasked and undropped.
